_comment: Third-party partner/integration marks — NOT OpenMined's brand. Each is the trademark of its owner, used nominatively to identify the tool. Sourced from official brand resources (or CC0 Simple Icons glyphs for monochrome icons). Never recolor a mark where the owner's guidelines forbid it; never imply endorsement. OMDS color tokens do NOT apply to these. Icons named `icon.svg` use fill=currentColor (theme via `color`); `icon-color.svg` carries the official brand color. Lockups: `logo*.svg` is the color/primary lockup; `logo-mono.svg` is the 1-color (currentColor) variant. Google has no mono lockup (its guidelines forbid a monochrome Google logo).

github.name: GitHub
github.notes: Official (GitHub_Logos.zip). Monochrome by design — use black or white only per GitHub guidelines. Icon = Invertocat.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.notes: Official production lockup SVG (next.ramp.com), monochrome by design (currentColor). icon = the Ramp swoosh mark (community dashboard-icons set, single-color/currentColor).

google.name: Google
google.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color 'G' (DO NOT recolor — Google guidelines). icon.svg = a 1-color knockout of that same G geometry (currentColor). Lockups: 'Google Workspace' wordmark + plain 'Google' 4-color wordmark (Wikimedia, PD-textlogo), each with a currentColor knockout (Google discourages recoloring — prefer color externally). Individual Workspace product icons (Gmail/Drive/Calendar/…) live under `products/` — see the `products` block below.

products._comment: Google product icons (Workspace + Analytics + Cloud) — official 2020-generation multicolor artwork (Wikimedia Commons). COLOR-ONLY by Google's guidelines (no monochrome/recolored product icons), so no 1-color variant. Each keeps its intrinsic aspect ratio. <product>.svg = vector (web); <product>.png = 512px-tall transparent raster (for Notion/doc icons via link). Used nominatively to identify the product; never imply endorsement; never recolor.

notion.name: Notion
notion.notes: Monochrome by design (black + reversed white). Icon = the 'N'. lockup = N + 'Notion' wordmark (svgporn community CDN — Notion ships no fetchable official lockup file; verify against notion.so/brand).

asana.name: Asana
asana.notes: lockup = 3-dot symbol + 'asana' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo). Asana discourages standalone use of the symbol — prefer the lockup. Never place on a coral background.

slack.name: Slack
slack.notes: icon-color = the official 4-color hash from Slack's CDN — never recolor. icon.svg = monochrome glyph. lockup = 4-color hash + 'Slack' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo).

claude.name: Claude
claude.notes: Official (Anthropic press kit). Icon = the Claude Spark (clay #D97757). Lockup in Slate (default), Ivory (on dark), and one-color.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.notes: Sprocket mark. lockup = sprocket + 'HubSpot' wordmark (Wikimedia Commons, PD-textlogo). Referential use only — keep your name more prominent, include an independence disclaimer.

1password.name: 1Password
1password.notes: Official lockup from the press CDN (mono black + white). Recent rebrand ships separate company and product marks — verify which is intended.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.notes: icon = the 3-ripple mark (currentColor); icon-color = same mark in brand plum #402530 (matches the 1-color geometry — not the app-badge). lockup = supplied official vector, plum + currentColor knockout.

loom.name: Loom
loom.notes: Single-color mark (the aperture/burst logomark). icon-color = the mark in brand purple #625DF5; icon.svg = same geometry as currentColor. Mark from Simple Icons (CC0, canonical 0 0 24 24, normalized to ~86% like the other icons). lockup = mark + 'loom' wordmark (purple + near-black; mono = currentColor knockout).

figma.name: Figma
figma.notes: Multicolor mark (the 5-shape logo: #F24E1E #FF7262 #A259FF #1ABCFE #0ACF83 — never recolor the color variant). icon-color = the official 5-color mark fit to a 0 0 24 24 box at ~86% (Slack technique) so it swaps in place with icon.svg, the currentColor 1-color knockout (Simple Icons silhouette). lockup = mark + 'Figma' wordmark; mono = full currentColor knockout.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.notes: Single-color brand (LinkedIn blue #0A66C2). icon = the 'in' bug (the 'in' knocked out of the rounded square); icon-color = same in brand blue, icon.svg = currentColor. Mark from Simple Icons (CC0, canonical 0 0 24 24, ~86%). lockup = the one-color 'Linked·in' logo in blue; mono = currentColor knockout. Per LinkedIn brand: don't alter the bug's proportions or recolor the color variant.

bluesky.name: Bluesky
bluesky.notes: Single-color butterfly mark (#1185FE). Simple Icons geometry, canonical 24-box @86%.

x.name: X (Twitter)
x.notes: Monochrome by design — the X mark IS the logo (black/white only per X brand toolkit); no wordmark lockup exists. Covers the former Twitter accounts.

adobe.name: Adobe
adobe.notes: Single-color 'A' mark in Adobe red (#FA0F00). Covers Adobe Creative Suite/Cloud references. lockup = A + 'Adobe' wordmark; mono = currentColor knockout.

aws.name: AWS
aws.notes: Two-tone mark ('aws' squid-ink #232F3E + smile #FF9900). icon-color = official two-tone fit to the 24-box (Slack technique); icon.svg = currentColor silhouette. Covers the AWS / Route 53 rows. lockup = same official logo at natural aspect.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.notes: icon = the official post-2022 app badge (orange box + white wordmark — matches zapier.com favicon); icon-color in Zapier orange #FF4F00. lockup = the '_zapier' brandmark (orange underscore + near-black wordmark); mono = currentColor knockout.

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.notes: Single-color 'W' circle mark in WordPress blue (#21759B). lockup = mark + 'WordPress' wordmark; mono = currentColor knockout. Trademark note: 'WordPress' (capital P) per foundation policy.

azure.name: Microsoft Azure
azure.notes: icon-color = the official gradient 'A' mark fit to the 24-box (never recolor); icon.svg = currentColor silhouette (Simple Icons geometry).

readthedocs.name: Read the Docs
readthedocs.notes: Monochrome by design (post-2023 simplified brand) — use black or theme via currentColor.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Monochrome cube mark — black/white by design; theme via currentColor.

pypi.name: PyPI
pypi.notes: icon = the official isometric package-boxes mark (dense — prefer >=32px display); icon-color in PyPI blue #3775A9.
gaps: no official wordmark-lockup vector (community file is the bare mark only)

miro.name: Miro
miro.notes: icon-color = the official yellow tile (#FFDD33) with the negative-space M, fit to the 24-box; icon.svg = currentColor silhouette. lockup color-only (mark is negative space on yellow — no clean 1-color knockout).
gaps: lockup is color-only (negative-space mark, no clean mono)

docker.name: Docker
docker.notes: Single-color whale mark in Docker blue (#2496ED). lockup = whale + 'docker' wordmark; mono = currentColor knockout.
